headline: Updates for everyone, and releases that publish themselves
pill: check for updates, even when installed from GitHub
summary: Turnhuddle now checks for new versions itself, so installs from GitHub stay current too. Plus a clearer Activity Bar icon, a fix for the streaming cursor, and every release now published automatically with notes and a downloadable VSIX.
improvements: A new Activity Bar icon, two arrows taking turns, that stays legible at small sizes.
Each release now comes with a GitHub Release that includes the VSIX, for installing without the Marketplace.
This website, with every release explained.
fixes: While Claude streams a list, the typing cursor now sits at the end of the text instead of on a line of its own.

highlights.title: Check for updates
highlights.text: Once a day Turnhuddle asks GitHub for the latest release. If there's a newer one, a notification offers to install it: the VSIX is downloaded, its checksum verified against GitHub's, and installed for you. Run **Turnhuddle: Check for Updates** any time, or turn the daily check off with `turnhuddle.checkForUpdates`.
